CREATE TABLE "public"."Ambulance" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "driverName" text,
  "driverPhone" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "operatorId" text,
  "registrationNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'OFFLINE' NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Ambulance_status_check_794151b7" CHECK ("status" IN ('AVAILABLE', 'ASSIGNED', 'EN_ROUTE', 'ARRIVED', 'TRANSPORTING', 'COMPLETED', 'OFFLINE')),
  CONSTRAINT "Ambulance_type_check_3333d079" CHECK ("type" IN ('BASIC', 'ADVANCED', 'ICU'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Appointment" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" text NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "startsAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'REQUESTED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Appointment_status_check_0d794e1f" CHECK ("status" IN ('REQUESTED', 'CONFIRMED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AuditLog" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actorId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entity" text,
  "entityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BloodDonor" (
  "bloodGroup" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "lastDonationDate" timestamptz,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BloodRequest" (
  "bloodGroup" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "requesterId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "units" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "BloodRequest_status_check_7c0728a4" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'FULFILLED', 'PARTIALLY_FULFILLED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."BloodUnit" (
  "bloodGroup" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "units" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Doctor" (
  "bio" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "licenseNumber" text,
  "specialization" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DoctorAvailability" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "doctorId" text NOT NULL,
  "endMinute" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "slotMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 30 NOT NULL,
  "startMinute" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "weekday" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EmergencyRequest" (
  "cancelReason" text,
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "destinationAddress" text,
  "destinationFacilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text,
  "pickupAddress" text,
  "pickupLatitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "pickupLongitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "priority" text NOT NULL,
  "requesterId" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "EmergencyRequest_category_check_0afdbf97" CHECK ("category" IN ('MEDICAL', 'ACCIDENT', 'INJURY', 'PREGNANCY', 'BREATHING', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "EmergencyRequest_priority_check_0838e5f0" CHECK ("priority" IN ('LOW', 'MEDIUM', 'HIGH', 'CRITICAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "EmergencyRequest_status_check_5462a746" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'MATCHED', 'ASSIGNED', 'EN_ROUTE', 'ARRIVED', 'TRANSPORTING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Feedback" (
  "authorId" text NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "moderationReason" text,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Feedback_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."HealthcareFacility" (
  "address" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "emergencyAvailable" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "operatingHours" text,
  "phone" text,
  "services" text[] NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "HealthcareFacility_services_elem_not_null_4d2c6c0f" CHECK (array_position("services", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "HealthcareFacility_type_check_07fe5e48" CHECK ("type" IN ('HOSPITAL', 'HEALTH_POST'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."LocationUpdate" (
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "recordedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "tripId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."MedicalRecord" (
  "attachments" text[] NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "diagnosis" text,
  "doctorId" text,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "patientId" text NOT NULL,
  "prescriptions" text[] NOT NULL,
  "recordType" text DEFAULT 'CONSULTATION' NOT NULL,
  "treatment" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "MedicalRecord_attachments_elem_not_null_d71f0c0b" CHECK (array_position("attachments", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "MedicalRecord_prescriptions_elem_not_null_503c7a44" CHECK (array_position("prescriptions", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "MedicalRecord_recordType_check_76e4e61b" CHECK ("recordType" IN ('CONSULTATION', 'PRESCRIPTION', 'LAB_RESULT', 'IMAGING', 'VACCINATION', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "body" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "link" text,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OrganDonor" (
  "consent" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "organs" text[] NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PLEDGED' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "OrganDonor_organs_elem_not_null_cd4522bf" CHECK (array_position("organs", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "OrganDonor_status_check_01517025" CHECK ("status" IN ('PLEDGED', 'VERIFIED', 'INACTIVE'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Patient" (
  "address" text,
  "bloodGroup" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dateOfBirth" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PlatformSetting" (
  "key" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "value" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("key")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Trip" (
  "ambulanceId" text NOT NULL,
  "arrivedAt" timestamptz,
  "completedAt" timestamptz,
  "emergencyRequestId" text NOT NULL,
  "endedAt" timestamptz,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "startedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'EN_ROUTE' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Trip_status_check_e190a2e6" CHECK ("status" IN ('EN_ROUTE', 'ARRIVED', 'TRANSPORTING', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "facilityId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'PATIENT' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "verificationStatus" text DEFAULT 'VERIFIED' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "User_role_check_7ce26ebb" CHECK ("role" IN ('PATIENT', 'DOCTOR', 'FACILITY_STAFF', 'AMBULANCE_OPERATOR', 'BLOOD_DONOR', 'ORGAN_DONOR', 'ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "User_verificationStatus_check_ca662e8d" CHECK ("verificationStatus" IN ('PENDING', 'VERIFIED', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."VerificationRequest" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "documentUrls" text[] NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "kind" text NOT NULL,
  "payload" text,
  "reason" text,
  "reviewedAt" timestamptz,
  "reviewedById" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "VerificationRequest_documentUrls_elem_not_null_b73c3f87" CHECK (array_position("documentUrls", NULL) IS NULL),
  CONSTRAINT "VerificationRequest_kind_check_cc37062a" CHECK ("kind" IN ('DOCTOR', 'FACILITY', 'AMBULANCE')),
  CONSTRAINT "VerificationRequest_status_check_56005a61" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
)
